mutations.name: a merge-at-head deposit never joins its PR's live row
kills: a deposit's typed op shows the live row's g10 hold on a merge-at-head, so the page can offer the approve-and-wait tap beside the forced merge

mutations.name: a deploy-pause-clear deposit gets no console tap
kills: a deposit's typed op becomes an owner-op tap for a deploy-pause-clear

mutations.name: a factory-config-set deposit gets a console tap before its effect lands
kills: a deposit's typed op stays on the terminal for a kind with no console tap yet

mutations.name: inbox.list drops the missed-notice rows
kills: inbox.list's machine-derived rows a round notice the start-up sweep could not send lists a missed-notice row linking the round until a later sweep reaches the seat

mutations.name: inbox.list drops the round notices gap
kills: inbox.list's machine-derived rows a round notice the start-up sweep could not send names an unreadable rounds dir as a round notices gap
